name: Young Rat 46
author: nishikalewis
description: Outlined rounded teal button that lifts and glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, border-color becomes #ff00ff, text color changes from #00ffff to #ffffff, box-shadow becomes 0 0.6em 0.6em -0.3em #ff00ff.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Young Rat 46</title>
<style>
/* Young Rat 46 by nishikalewis — https://uiverse.io/nishikalewis/young-rat-46 */
button {
  background: none;
  color: cyan;
  border: 2px solid cyan;
  padding: 1em 2em;
  font-size: 1em;
  border-radius: 0.5em;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.25s ease-in-out;
}

button:hover {
  border-color: magenta;
  color: white;
  box-shadow: 0 0.6em 0.6em -0.3em magenta;
  transform: translateY(-0.3em);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">Hover me</button>

</body>
</html>
